Dulāla_Vaijala
or Devaº or Vaijalabhūpati, Chauhan Zamindar of Patna (17th Cent.); patron of Jaganmohana Paṇḍita (a. of (Ṣaṭpañcāśat) Deśāvalīvivṛti).
See NCC. VII. p. 144a.
